## Summary

Describe the change and why it is needed.

## Checks

- [ ] `cargo fmt --all -- --check`
- [ ] `cargo check`
- [ ] `cargo test`
- [ ] `cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings`
- [ ] No secrets, vault files, API keys or keyfiles included
- [ ] Documentation updated where needed

## Security impact

Describe any effect on cryptography, KDF settings, keyfiles, backups, clipboard handling or network requests.
